Release.Note: The update catalogue and its signature are read from one file, so they always match, even in the minutes right after a release is published.
New firmware is offered from the release that brings it, together with the definitions it needs; older installations are offered the update of iDM3 instead.
The Overview shows the Firmware row only when published firmware is missing, with a Download button; every file is checked against the signed catalogue.
The update check says when no signed catalogue is published, instead of reporting that iDM3 is offline.
A build that is newer than the published release keeps its own firmware files instead of offering older published copies.
A readable description is shown for every CU error code.
Hidden objects are no longer shown by default; function block templates are saved to the project and new projects start from the default project.
The "Auto restore project at the CU" setting is hidden: miniCU does not support it.

The Overview page says when a newer version of iDM3 has been published.
Announcements and release notes are published, so they can be updated without a new version of iDM3.
The Overview page shows release notes for iDM3 and for the published firmware.
The version is shown as 3.6.5 rather than with the generated build number after it.
Unit definitions, parameters and enumerations are published, so a new device type no longer needs a reinstall.
Fixed an update that reported itself as ready after every restart.
The Overview page replaces the dashboard: announcements, version and update status, and a link to the user manual.
Device firmware and language files are downloaded from the published catalogue instead of shipping inside the installer.
Added the IBWL3-02B and IBWL3-20B relays.
Added DALI-2 input device support.
